title: Ловушки ОГЭ (Первое условное / First Conditional)
description: Выбери правильную форму: без will после if/when!

items.question: If it ___ , I will stay at home.
I will call you when I ___.
She will be angry if we ___ late.
We will go to the beach if the weather ___ fine.
If he ___ , he will fail the exam.
